verdict.rationale: The evidence pack focuses entirely on Pipedream MCP as an on-demand tool-calling server (managed auth, tool execution, transports) with no mention of cron-style scheduling, recurring triggers, or persistent workflow automation via MCP. Since Pipedream's broader platform is workflow automation, a buyer could reasonably expect scheduling support, but nothing in this evidence pack demonstrates that Pipedream MCP itself exposes or manages recurring jobs.
